name: Bichlalm
kurzbeschreibung: The **Bichlalm** at **1,440 m** is a popular hiking and day-trip destination with stunning panoramic views of the **Kitzbüheler Alpen**.
beschreibung: Bichlalm – Nestled in the breathtaking Tyrolean landscape, the Bichlalm is a true gem of the Kitzbühel region. Perched at 1,440 meters above sea level, this spot is a popular hiking and day-trip destination, offering stunning panoramic views of the Kitzbühel Alps. The perfect blend of nature, Tyrolean hospitality, and easy accessibility makes Bichlalm an ideal destination for a day out, whether you're visiting alone, with a partner, or with your whole family. Located in Aurach bei Kitzbühel within the Kitzbühel region, the Bichlalm is well-signposted, with free parking and proximity to other attractions ensuring a convenient visit. The combination of awe-inspiring scenery and warm hospitality makes this a truly unforgettable experience.
